dimensions.description: Makes the private dependency reachable by canonical name without advertising it as a user-facing writing goal.

evals.name: canonical-dependency-invocation
evals.prompt:
/writing-foundation

Apply the shared writing contract requested by the consuming Skill.
evals.expected_output: The canonical private dependency is available when it is explicitly invoked by name.
expectations: The host records invocation of writing-foundation by its canonical name.

evals.name: private-user-goal-false-activation
evals.prompt: Make this customer update clearer and friendlier for a nontechnical reader.
evals.expected_output: The host does not select writing-foundation as a public user-facing writing outcome.
expectations: The private dependency does not activate from a user-facing writing goal.
